title: Binance Will List Manchester City Fan Token (CITY)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Manchester City Fan Token (CITY) and will open trading for CITY/BTC, CITY/BNB, CITY/BUSD, and CITY/USDT trading pairs at 2021-11-10 08:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  CITY  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for CITY will open at 2021-11-11 08:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Manchester City Fan Token (CITY)? Manchester City Fan Token (CITY) is a utility token that gives Manchester City Football Club fans a tokenized share of influence on club decisions using Socios, a fan engagement and rewards platform for sports and entertainment organizations.
